title: Introduction to Software Development
topics: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)

questions.question: What is the main purpose of software development?
options: To create programs for specific tasks
questions.explanation:
Software development creates software to solve needs.
اردو وضاحت: سافٹ ویئر ڈویلپمنٹ میں پروگرام بنانا، اس کی جانچ کرنا اور غلطیاں دور کرنا شامل ہے۔

questions.question: Which activity belongs to software development?
questions.explanation: Coding is a core software-development activity.

questions.question: What should be checked before software is released?
questions.explanation: Testing helps confirm expected behavior.

questions.question: What is a bug in a software program?
questions.explanation: A bug is a mistake causing unexpected behavior.

questions.question: Which action directly corrects a detected bug?
questions.explanation:
Debugging is the process of finding and fixing errors.
اردو وضاحت: سافٹ ویئر ڈویلپمنٹ میں پروگرام بنانا، اس کی جانچ کرنا اور غلطیاں دور کرنا شامل ہے۔

questions.question: Which is an example of software?
questions.explanation: An application is software used to perform tasks.

questions.question: Why is planning useful before coding?
options: It removes all need for testing
questions.explanation: Planning helps define what the software must do.

questions.question: Which statement best describes software maintenance?
options: It is always done before coding
questions.explanation: Maintenance continues after deployment.

questions.question: A student builds a calculator application. This is an example of what?
questions.explanation: Building a calculator application is software creation.

questions.question: Which sequence makes sense for creating a simple app?
questions.explanation:
A software solution begins by understanding the task.
اردو وضاحت: سافٹ ویئر ڈویلپمنٹ میں پروگرام بنانا، اس کی جانچ کرنا اور غلطیاں دور کرنا شامل ہے۔

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of SDLC?
questions.explanation:
SDLC structures development from initial idea to maintenance.
اردو وضاحت: SDLC سافٹ ویئر بنانے کے مراحل کو منظم کرتا ہے۔ Functional ضرورت کام بتاتی ہے جبکہ Non-functional معیار بتاتی ہے۔

questions.question: Which SDLC phase identifies user needs?
questions.explanation: Requirements are collected before design and coding.

questions.question: Which is a functional requirement?
questions.explanation: A functional requirement states an action the system performs.

questions.question: Which is a non-functional requirement?
questions.explanation: Capacity is a quality/performance constraint.

questions.question: Which phase converts specifications into program code?
questions.explanation:
Implementation translates the design into code.
اردو وضاحت: SDLC سافٹ ویئر بنانے کے مراحل کو منظم کرتا ہے۔ Functional ضرورت کام بتاتی ہے جبکہ Non-functional معیار بتاتی ہے۔

questions.question: Which SDLC stage decides software structure and diagrams?
questions.explanation: Design specifies architecture, models, and components.

questions.question: Which stage makes the software available to users?
questions.explanation: Deployment installs or releases the working system.

questions.question: Which activity is typical of requirement gathering?
questions.explanation: Interviews and surveys identify stakeholder needs.

questions.question: Which SDLC phase includes updates after release?
questions.explanation: Maintenance fixes defects and adapts released software.

questions.question: Which statement best defines a software framework?
options: A reusable structure and components for apps
questions.explanation:
Frameworks provide predefined components and architecture.
اردو وضاحت: SDLC سافٹ ویئر بنانے کے مراحل کو منظم کرتا ہے۔ Functional ضرورت کام بتاتی ہے جبکہ Non-functional معیار بتاتی ہے۔

questions.question: Which methodology uses sequential development phases?
questions.explanation:
Waterfall progresses through defined phases.
اردو وضاحت: Waterfall میں مراحل ترتیب سے مکمل ہوتے ہیں جبکہ Agile میں مختصر iterations اور مسلسل feedback لیا جاتا ہے۔

questions.question: Which model is generally suitable when requirements are stable?
questions.explanation: Stable, well-defined requirements suit Waterfall.

questions.question: What is a sprint in Agile development?
questions.explanation: Agile work is organized into short iterations.

questions.question: Which is an Agile practice mentioned in the chapter?
questions.explanation: Continuous integration merges code changes regularly.

questions.question: Which approach commonly responds better to changing requirements?
questions.explanation:
Agile is designed for adapting through iterations.
اردو وضاحت: Waterfall میں مراحل ترتیب سے مکمل ہوتے ہیں جبکہ Agile میں مختصر iterations اور مسلسل feedback لیا جاتا ہے۔

questions.question: What is a challenge of the Waterfall model?
questions.explanation: Waterfall is less flexible after phase completion.

questions.question: In pair programming, how many developers work together at one workstation?
questions.explanation: Pair programming uses two developers collaborating.

questions.question: In test-driven development, developers typically write what first?
questions.explanation: TDD begins by defining expected behavior in tests.

questions.question: What is a benefit of Agile increments?
questions.explanation: Small deliverables enable frequent customer review.

questions.question: Which issue can complicate Agile projects involving many teams?
questions.explanation:
Agile at scale requires careful coordination.
اردو وضاحت: Waterfall میں مراحل ترتیب سے مکمل ہوتے ہیں جبکہ Agile میں مختصر iterations اور مسلسل feedback لیا جاتا ہے۔

questions.question: What is the main purpose of project planning?
options: To understand scope, time and cost
questions.explanation:
Planning defines project work, schedule, and resources.
اردو وضاحت: Project planning میں اہداف، وقت، اخراجات، خطرات اور معیار کی جانچ کا انتظام کیا جاتا ہے۔

questions.question: Which factor generally affects development cost?
questions.explanation: The number and skill of developers influence cost.

questions.question: What does a project timeline specify?
questions.explanation: A timeline schedules project activities.

questions.question: Which step comes first in risk management?
questions.explanation: Risks must be identified before mitigation.

questions.question: What does risk mitigation mean?
options: Reducing the impact of identified risks
questions.explanation:
Mitigation is a response plan to limit risk.
اردو وضاحت: Project planning میں اہداف، وقت، اخراجات، خطرات اور معیار کی جانچ کا انتظام کیا جاتا ہے۔

questions.question: Which is an example of a technical project risk?
questions.explanation: Technology failures can disrupt delivery.

questions.question: Which activity belongs to execution?
questions.explanation: Execution is the active implementation phase.

questions.question: What is the purpose of quality assurance?
options: To verify standards and correct operation
questions.explanation: QA checks software quality throughout the project.

questions.question: What is a milestone?
questions.explanation: Milestones mark progress toward major deliverables.

questions.question: What should a team do when a major new risk appears?
options: Review the risk and adjust plans
questions.explanation:
Continuous monitoring allows prompt response.
اردو وضاحت: Project planning میں اہداف، وقت، اخراجات، خطرات اور معیار کی جانچ کا انتظام کیا جاتا ہے۔

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: What does UML stand for?
questions.explanation:
UML is the standard visual modeling language discussed here.
اردو وضاحت: UML کے ذریعے سسٹم کو diagram کی شکل میں دکھایا جاتا ہے۔ ہر diagram مختلف پہلو واضح کرتا ہے۔

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: Which UML diagram shows interactions from a user perspective?
questions.explanation: Use cases describe how actors interact with system functions.

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: In a use case diagram, an actor represents what?
options: A user or external system interacting with the system
questions.explanation: Actors are people or other systems outside the modeled system.

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: Which diagram primarily represents classes and their relationships?
questions.explanation: Class diagrams describe structural organization.

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: Which diagram emphasizes messages over time?
questions.explanation:
Sequence diagrams show time-ordered interactions.
اردو وضاحت: UML کے ذریعے سسٹم کو diagram کی شکل میں دکھایا جاتا ہے۔ ہر diagram مختلف پہلو واضح کرتا ہے۔

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: Which diagram represents workflow and decisions?
questions.explanation: Activity diagrams model process flow and decisions.

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: What does an attribute describe in a class diagram?
options: A property of a class or object
questions.explanation: Attributes describe data held by objects.

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: Which is an example of a method?
questions.explanation: Methods represent operations or behaviors.

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: What is the purpose of identifying actors in use case modeling?
options: To determine system users or external systems
questions.explanation: Actors identify who interacts with the system.

questions.topic: 1.5 Graphical Representation and UML (Supplementary: excluded in 2027)
questions.question: Which notation generally shows a choice in an activity diagram?
questions.explanation:
Diamonds represent decision points in activity diagrams.
اردو وضاحت: UML کے ذریعے سسٹم کو diagram کی شکل میں دکھایا جاتا ہے۔ ہر diagram مختلف پہلو واضح کرتا ہے۔

questions.question: What is a software design pattern?
options: A reusable solution to a common design problem
questions.explanation:
Patterns provide established approaches to recurring problems.
اردو وضاحت: Design patterns عام مسائل کے دوبارہ استعمال ہونے والے حل ہیں، مثلاً Observer تبدیلی پر متعلقہ افراد کو اطلاع دیتا ہے۔

questions.question: Which pattern is intended to permit one instance of a class?
questions.explanation: Singleton controls creation so one instance is shared.

questions.question: Which pattern helps create objects without exposing all creation details?
questions.explanation: Factory separates object creation from its use.

questions.question: Which pattern notifies interested objects when a subject changes?
questions.explanation: Observer supports subscription and notification.

questions.question: Which pattern lets the program choose among alternative algorithms?
questions.explanation:
Strategy encapsulates alternative behaviors.
اردو وضاحت: Design patterns عام مسائل کے دوبارہ استعمال ہونے والے حل ہیں، مثلاً Observer تبدیلی پر متعلقہ افراد کو اطلاع دیتا ہے۔

questions.question: Which pattern suits a single shared configuration manager?
questions.explanation: A configuration manager can be maintained as one instance.

questions.question: Which pattern might notify followers about a new post?
questions.explanation: Observers receive updates after a subject changes.

questions.question: Why are design patterns used?
questions.explanation: Patterns can improve design clarity and reusability.

questions.question: Which pattern is suitable for producing different types of reports?
questions.explanation: A factory can centralize report-object creation.

questions.question: Which choice best represents the Strategy pattern?
options: One fixed object for all purposes
questions.explanation:
Strategy allows selecting an algorithm for a task.
اردو وضاحت: Design patterns عام مسائل کے دوبارہ استعمال ہونے والے حل ہیں، مثلاً Observer تبدیلی پر متعلقہ افراد کو اطلاع دیتا ہے۔

questions.question: What is debugging?
questions.explanation:
Debugging investigates and corrects bugs.
اردو وضاحت: Debugging غلطی تلاش اور درست کرتا ہے؛ Testing سافٹ ویئر کے درست کام کرنے کی جانچ ہے۔

questions.question: What is unit testing?
questions.explanation: Unit tests focus on a small testable part.

questions.question: Which testing checks interaction between modules?
questions.explanation: Integration tests verify combined component interactions.

questions.question: Which testing examines the application as a whole?
questions.explanation: System tests assess the entire integrated application.

questions.question: Who typically checks software against end-user expectations during acceptance testing?
questions.explanation:
Acceptance verifies whether delivered software meets needs.
اردو وضاحت: Debugging غلطی تلاش اور درست کرتا ہے؛ Testing سافٹ ویئر کے درست کام کرنے کی جانچ ہے۔

questions.question: Which debugging approach prints values during execution?
questions.explanation: Print statements expose runtime values.

questions.question: What does a debugger help a developer do?
questions.explanation: Debuggers help locate faults during program execution.

questions.question: Which is an example of a code review?
options: Another developer inspects code for issues
The editor changes the document font
questions.explanation: Reviews can spot code defects before release.

questions.question: Why is testing necessary?
options: To guarantee software never needs maintenance
To evaluate whether requirements are met
questions.explanation: Testing checks expected behavior and quality.

questions.question: What is the usual progression from narrow to broader testing?
questions.explanation:
Testing can progress from components to full product acceptance.
اردو وضاحت: Debugging غلطی تلاش اور درست کرتا ہے؛ Testing سافٹ ویئر کے درست کام کرنے کی جانچ ہے۔

questions.question: What is the main use of a code editor?
questions.explanation:
Code editors help create and modify code.
اردو وضاحت: Code editor کوڈ لکھنے، compiler/interpreter اسے چلانے، debugger غلطیاں تلاش کرنے اور repository کوڈ محفوظ کرنے میں مدد دیتی ہے۔

questions.question: Which tool commonly translates code line by line?
questions.explanation: Interpreters execute code stepwise as described in the chapter.

questions.question: Which tool typically translates an entire program before execution?
questions.explanation: Compilers translate complete programs to executable form.

questions.question: What does IDE stand for?
questions.explanation: IDEs combine programming-related tools.

questions.question: Which is an IDE mentioned in the chapter?
questions.explanation:
Visual Studio is a full integrated development environment.
اردو وضاحت: Code editor کوڈ لکھنے، compiler/interpreter اسے چلانے، debugger غلطیاں تلاش کرنے اور repository کوڈ محفوظ کرنے میں مدد دیتی ہے۔

questions.question: Which tool helps trace mistakes in source code?
questions.explanation: A debugger helps developers identify errors.

questions.question: Which is an example of a source code repository platform?
questions.explanation: GitHub hosts repositories for projects.

questions.question: What is a benefit of source code repositories?
questions.explanation: Repositories provide version history and collaboration support.

questions.question: Which platform type requires internet/cloud access in the chapter?
questions.explanation: Online environments are accessed through the internet.

questions.question: Which environment typically runs locally on a developer computer?
questions.explanation:
Offline development can use local tools without the internet.
اردو وضاحت: Code editor کوڈ لکھنے، compiler/interpreter اسے چلانے، debugger غلطیاں تلاش کرنے اور repository کوڈ محفوظ کرنے میں مدد دیتی ہے۔
